documentation.subject: TEST ONLY - DC46 alert delivery check - no action needed
documentation.content:
## This is a test. Nothing is wrong.

This temporary policy opens an incident because the DC46 file-link worker **is working** (it answered a scheduled run). Its only purpose is to prove that alert email reaches both DC46 recipients.

**What to do:** reply to the person running the test to confirm you received this email, and note the time it arrived. Take no other action.

The policy is deleted as soon as both recipients have confirmed. If you still see it a day later, tell the Product Owner.

Procedure: `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`, section *DC46-C monitoring readiness*, *Delivery test*.
